ssc_M3_016.rationale: ANGPT2 competes at TEK/Tie2, destabilising endothelium — cited PMID 40029709 (Ang2 antagonist conversion) supports; 33333969 shows Ang-2 activates SSc monocytes (SSc relevance).

ssc_M3_017.rationale: TGF-β/SMAD3 induces TWIST1 (EndMT master TF) — cited PMID 16123809 (TGF-β-driven EMT transcription factors) supports.

ssc_M3_018.rationale: SNAI1/2 repress the endothelial-identity panel (CDH5/CD31/VWF/TEK) — cited PMID 28062404 (SSc EndoMT) supports.

ssc_M3_019.rationale: COX-2/PTGS2 produces thromboxane TXA2 signalling via TBXA2R (vasoconstriction) — cited PMID 37321373 (thromboxane A2 receptor signalling review) supports; SSc digital ischaemia.

ssc_M3_020.rationale: HIF1A partners ARNT in the nucleus — cited PMID 7539918 is the classic Wang/Semenza HIF-1α/ARNT bHLH-PAS paper. Canonical, correct.

ssc_M3_021.rationale: TGF-β/SMAD3 induces ZEB2/SIP1 (EndMT TF) — cited PMID 19838011 (TGF-β-Smad induces ZEB1/ZEB2/Snail) directly supports.

ssc_M3_022.rationale: NOTCH3 engaged by JAG1 (pericyte/VSMC Notch) — cited PMID 31868216 (Notch3 in vascular smooth muscle) supports; NOTCH3/CADASIL pericyte axis.

ssc_M3_023.rationale: FLI1 maintains endothelial CDH5 identity; its SSc reduction permits EndoMT — cited PMID 28062404 + dossier 20228226 (endothelial Fli1 deficiency impairs vascular homeostasis in scleroderma vasculopathy) strongly support.

ssc_M3_024.rationale: MMP-12-dependent uPAR (PLAUR) cleavage drives SSc-serum-induced EndoMT — cited PMID 28062404 (SSc EndoMT, MMP-12/uPAR) supports.

ssc_M3_025.rationale: ET-1 enhances collagen I/III release by SSc dermal fibroblasts via EDNRA/B — cited PMID 9595482 directly states this. Profibrotic ET-1→fibroblast axis.

ssc_M3_026.rationale: Agonistic anti-AT1R/anti-ETAR autoantibodies induce endothelial TGF-β — cited PMID 26970493 (agonistic AT1R/ETAR autoAb in SSc, Riemekasten) supports; distinct from the contested anti-PDGFR claim.

ssc_M3_027.rationale: TGF-β1 upregulates EDN1 — cited PMID 19335743 (SSc TGF-β/ET-1 review) supports; 12021584 (ETA blockade lowers collagen) corroborates the ET-1/fibrosis link.

ssc_M2_056.rationale: NOX4-dependent H2O2 drives TGF-β1-induced myofibroblast differentiation — cited PMID 25040787 (Nox4 regulates the activated state of SSc dermal fibroblasts) directly supports.

ssc_M2_057.rationale: αv-containing integrins (ITGAV) bind/activate latent TGF-β — cited PMID 16436664 (αv integrins activate latent TGF-β in fibrosis) supports; canonical integrin-mediated TGF-β activation.
